equipment_type: Boiler operating controller (RWF55) via ProtoNode gateway
applies_to: Thermal Solutions EVA, EVAW, EVO and EVOW boilers whose operating control is an RWF55, connected through a ProtoNode FPC-N34.
summary: Thermal Solutions EVA/EVAW/EVO/EVOW boilers with an RWF55 controller are read through a ProtoNode FPC-N34 gateway that polls the RWF55 over Modbus RTU and serves it on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP. The profile has 10 objects: three analog inputs, the active setpoint, writable Setpoint 1 and 2, actuator position and a burner alarm value.
default_device_instance: 50000 + the controller's Modbus Node-ID (Node_Offset default 50,000, changeable in the Web Configurator)
notes: Each connected controller shows up as its own BACnet device on the ProtoNode FPC-N34 gateway.
The table has no read/write column; access here is inferred from the LonWorks direction (nvi = writable) in the same table.
The guide gives no engineering units or value ranges; units follow the controller's own configuration.
Two objects share the name Analog Input InP3: AI 3 and AI 7 (the LonWorks name marks AI 7 as the unfiltered value).

integration.summary: Wire the RWF55 R+/R- terminals to the ProtoNode, set it to 19200 8N1 with a unique Node-ID, add the RWF55 profile in the Web Configurator, and discover it at 50000 + Node-ID. Setpoint 1 and Setpoint 2 are the only writable objects; the rest is monitoring.

minimum_points.name: Analog Input InP1
minimum_points.why: Input InP1 reading; units per controller setup

minimum_points.name: Burner Alarm
minimum_points.why: Burner alarm; code meanings not given in the guide

minimum_points.name: Com Status
minimum_points.why: Modbus link between ProtoNode and the RWF55

integration.enable: The guide gives no remote-enable procedure; only Setpoint 1 (AV 5) and Setpoint 2 (AV 6) are writable.
setup: Device instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + the controller's Modbus Node-ID, so Node-ID 1 gives 50001.
ProtoNode default IP is 192.168.1.24 (255.255.255.0); change it in the FS-GUI under Setup > Network Settings.
FPC-N34 S-bank DIP switches pick the protocol: all Off = BACnet IP, S0 On = BACnet MS/TP, S2 On = BACnet MS/TP single node.
BACnet MS/TP: one MAC address (1-127) for the whole ProtoNode on A-bank DIP switches; baud on B-bank switches, factory default 38400.
Modbus side: every RWF40, RWF55 and RM7800 must run Modbus RTU at 19200, 8N1 with a unique Node-ID (1-255); add each one as a profile in the Web Configurator.
With more than one controller on a ProtoNode set BACnet Virtual Server Nodes to Yes; give each ProtoNode on a subnet its own BACnet Network Number (default 50).
gotchas: AI 3 and AI 7 are both named Analog Input InP3; AI 7 is the unfiltered value.
RWF55 wiring: R+ to ProtoNode Tx+, R- to Rx-; the RWF55 has no ground terminal.
